title: Agent monitors
description: Persistent checks in an existing conversation, even when your browser is closed. The Mergeron service must remain running.
humanPriority: You can keep talking to the agent: checks wait until it is available, then continue automatically. Only an explicit pause, a completed objective, a limit or an issue requiring your attention stops them.
adminOnly: Monitor management requires an administrator signed in with their own personal account, without impersonation.
empty: No monitors. Create one here; the agent can also schedule follow-up checks itself when useful for its assigned task.
agentLimits: From the agent: one unfinished plan per conversation, at most 20 checks over 24 hours, 5 minutes per check. Rights are inherited from the current turn without elevation. Broader limits require your explicit choice in the form.
error: Operation unconfirmed. Refresh the state before retrying; do not create a second monitor to bypass an error.
unknownReason: Check agent availability, permissions and monitor limits before resuming.
name: Name
writeGrant: I also authorize workspace writes for this monitor, within the scope of my instructions.
policyWarning: Conversation permissions are not changed. A read-only monitor requires an effectively read-only conversation. The write grant does not allow full access, automatic approval responses or remote actions without an explicit request.
limitsWarning: From 1 to 100 checks, at least 1 minute apart, for at most 30 days; 30 seconds to 30 minutes per check. These limits bound work, not guaranteed monetary spending. At most two simultaneous checks across the instance.
formDescription: Choose the existing agent and explicit limits. Never put passwords or tokens in the instructions.
stopHint: Does not interrupt current work or undo actions already performed.
deleteConfirm: Delete this monitor and its history? This does not undo the effects of previous checks.
historyDescription: The last 100 checks are retained. Response-ready notifications report a different summary, a completed objective or required attention, according to your notification preferences.

reasons.userTakeover: You resumed the conversation. Monitoring remains scheduled and waits for agent availability.
reasons.agentBusy: The agent is working or awaiting a response. The check will be deferred without interrupting your conversation.
reasons.policyExceedsGrant: Current conversation permissions exceed the authorized scope. Correct them before resuming.
reasons.policyUnknown: Effective permissions could not be verified. Open the agent and verify them before resuming.
reasons.approvalRequired: The check awaits approval or a human response; no response is supplied automatically.
reasons.accessRevoked: The monitor’s originating account no longer has the required access.
reasons.timeout: The check reached its maximum duration. Its interruption was requested.
reasons.dispatchUncertain: Check delivery is uncertain. Inspect the conversation before resuming.
reasons.stopUnconfirmed: Interruption was not confirmed. Automatic replay is forbidden.
reasons.engineRestart: The engine restarted during a check; inspect its effects before resuming.
reasons.backendRestart: Mergeron restarted during a check; inspect its effects before resuming.
reasons.runLimit: The maximum number of checks was reached.
reasons.limitReached: The authorized lifetime or number of checks is exhausted.
reasons.alreadyRunning: A check or uncertain delivery is still reserved. Inspect the conversation before resuming or deleting.
reasons.requestConflict: This request exists with different content. Check the list before scheduling another monitor.
reasons.invalidRequest: Check form fields, dates and limits.
reasons.invalidSchedule: The first check must precede expiry, within the next 30 days.
reasons.capacity: The project already has 20 active, paused or attention-required monitors. Finish one before adding another.
reasons.turnInterrupted: The check was interrupted. Inspect its effects before resuming.
reasons.agentLimit: An agent-created check is limited to 20 attempts, 24 hours and 5 minutes per attempt. Broader limits require your explicit choice in the interface.
reasons.threadCapacity: A monitor already exists for this conversation. Inspect it; the agent cannot create a duplicate to bypass its limits or an explicit pause.
